title: Exponential weighting over a growing list of traces
summary: Every symbol leaves a trace in a growing list; a probe weights each trace by the exponential of its similarity and returns the normalized weighted mix.
core_idea: Weight stored traces by the exponential of their similarity to a probe and mix them.

state.name: halbrook
state.meaning: Growing list of traces, one per symbol read.

learning.description: The similarity s is a fixed scaled product.
learning.few_shot_argument: Fixture only: no claim about learning speed is made beyond the toy case.

complexity.constants_notes: A handful of operations per symbol in the toy setting.

sample_efficiency.mechanism: Fixture only: the rule is fixed by hand.

prediction.statement: A unique trace is read after one write.

known_relatives.name: not assessed
known_relatives.claimed_difference: Fixture only; no difference is claimed.

falsifiers: Weights do not sum to one.

toy_example.python:
import json
import math
w = [math.exp(v) for v in (0.0, 1.0)]
print(json.dumps({'w1': round(w[1] / sum(w), 9)}))
